12081-lives-of-girls-who-became-famous.title: Girls Who Became Famous.
12081-lives-of-girls-who-became-famous.creator: Unknown
12081-lives-of-girls-who-became-famous.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In a plain home, in the town of Litchfield, Conn., was born, June 14, 1811, Harriet Beecher Stowe. The house was well-nigh full of little ones before her coming. She was the seventh child, while the oldest was but eleven years old.

arxiv-2102-11554.title: Consistent equivalence principle tests with fast radio bursts Consistent equivalence principle tests with fast radio bursts – Acknowledgments 2020
arxiv-2102-11554.creator: Robert Reischke, Steffen Hagstotz, Robert Lilow
arxiv-2102-11554.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Robert Reischke, Steffen Hagstotz, Robert Lilow. Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are astrophysical transients of still debated origin. So far several hundred events have been detected, mostly at extragalactic distances, and this number is expected to grow significantly over the next years. The radio signals from the burst experience dispersion as they travel through the free electrons along the line-of-sight characterised by the dispersion measure (DM) of the radio pulse.

arxiv-2106-13167.title: Polynomial unconstrained binary optimization inspired by optical simulation
arxiv-2106-13167.creator: D.A. Chermoshentsev, A.O. Malyshev, M. Esencan, E.S. Tiunov, D. Mendoza, A. Aspuru-Guzik, A.K. Fedorov, A.I. Lvovsky
arxiv-2106-13167.description: Abstract We propose an algorithm inspired by optical coherent Ising machines to solve the problem of polynomial unconstrained binary optimization (PUBO). We benchmark the proposed algorithm against existing PUBO algorithms on the extended Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model and random third-degree polynomial pseudo-Boolean functions, and observe its superior performance.

arxiv-2203-05100.title: Unwrapped two-point functions on high-dimensional tori
arxiv-2203-05100.creator: Youjin Deng, Timothy M. Garoni, Jens Grimm, Zongzheng Zhou
arxiv-2203-05100.description: Abstract We study unwrapped two-point functions for the Ising model, the self-avoiding walk and a random-length loop-erased random walk on high-dimensional lattices with periodic boundary conditions. While the standard two-point functions of these models have been observed to display an anomalous plateau behaviour, the unwrapped two-point functions are shown to display standard mean-field behaviour.

arxiv-2211-08300.title: Molecular Strong Coupling and Cavity Finesse
arxiv-2211-08300.creator: Kishan S. Menghrajani, Adarsh B. Vasista, Wai Jue Tan, Philip A. Thomas, Felipe Herrera, William L. Barnes
arxiv-2211-08300.description: Abstract Molecular strong coupling offers exciting prospects in physics, chemistry and materials science. Whilst attention has been focused on developing realistic models for the molecular systems, the important role played by the entire photonic mode structure of the optical cavities has been less explored. We show that the effectiveness of molecular strong coupling may be critically dependent on cavity finesse.

arxiv-2304-02464.title: Interface-dominated plasticity and kink bands in metallic nanolaminates
arxiv-2304-02464.creator: Abhishek Arora Rajat Arora Amit Acharya
arxiv-2304-02464.description: Abstract The theoretical and computational framework of finite deformation mesoscale field dislocation mechanics (MFDM) is used to understand the salient aspects of kink-band formation in Cu-Nb nano-metallic laminates (NMLs). A conceptually minimal, plane-strain idealization of the three-dimensional geometry, including crystalline orientation, of additively manufactured NML is used to model NMLs.

arxiv-2402-01554.title: Diastolic and isoperimetric inequalities on surfaces Thanks: The first author was supported by the Swiss National Science Foundation (grant 20-118014/1) during the redaction of this article. The second author has been partially supported by the Swiss National Science Foundation.
arxiv-2402-01554.creator: Florent Balacheff, Stéphane Sabourau
arxiv-2402-01554.description: Abstract . We prove an universal inequality between the diastole, defined using a minimax process on the one-cycle space, and the area of closed Riemannian surfaces. Roughly speaking, we show that any closed Riemannian surface can be swept out by a family of multi-loops whose lengths are bounded in terms of the area of the surface.

arxiv-2412-00231.title: Intermittent turbulent gusts lift eagles
arxiv-2412-00231.creator: Dipendra Gupta, David Brandes, Michael J Lanzone, Tricia Miller, Gregory P Bewley
arxiv-2412-00231.description: Abstract Turbulence grounds aircraft and combating it in flight requires energy, yet volant wildlife fly effortlessly even on windy days. The nature of the interactions between soaring birds and transient turbulent gusts is not clear, especially when compared with our understanding of flight in larger and steadier airflows during thermal or dynamic soaring.

arxiv-2412-07487.title: Stereo Hand-Object Reconstruction for Human-to-Robot Handover
arxiv-2412-07487.creator: Yik Lung Pang, Alessio Xompero, Changjae Oh, Andrea Cavallaro
arxiv-2412-07487.description: Abstract Jointly estimating hand and object shape facilitates the grasping task in human-to-robot handovers. Relying on hand-crafted prior knowledge about the geometric structure of the object fails when generalising to unseen objects, and depth sensors fail to detect transparent objects such as drinking glasses.

arxiv-2504-21472.title: Robust Orthogonal NMF with Label Propagation for Image Clustering
arxiv-2504-21472.creator: Jingjing Liu, Nian Wu, Xianchao Xiu, Jianhua Zhang
arxiv-2504-21472.description: Abstract Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a popular unsupervised learning approach widely used in image clustering. However, in real-world clustering scenarios, most existing NMF methods are highly sensitive to noise corruption and are unable to effectively leverage limited supervised information. To overcome these drawbacks, we propose a unified non-convex framework with label propagation called robust orthogonal nonnegative matrix factorization (RONMF).

arxiv-2508-01566.title: Investigation of nonlinear dipole cross sections
arxiv-2508-01566.creator: G.R. Boroun, B.Rezaei
arxiv-2508-01566.description: Abstract The nonlinear corrections to the Golec-Biernat Wusthoff (GBW) and Bartels- Golec- Kowalski (BGK) models, as discussed by Peredo-Hentschinski [M.A.Peredo and M.Hentschinski, Phys.Rev.D109, 014032 (2024)], are analyzed in terms of the gluon density , s nonlinear behavior. We incorporate these nonlinear corrections into the low x x gluon distribution of the modified BGK model for electron-ion colliders.

arxiv-2509-00854.title: Assessing the Advantages and Limitations of Quantum Neural Networks in Regression Tasks Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2509-00854.creator: Gubio G. de Lima, Tiago de S. Farias, Alexandre C. Ricardo, Celso Jorge Villa Boas
arxiv-2509-00854.description: Abstract The development of quantum neural networks (QNNs) has attracted considerable attention due to their potential to surpass classical models in certain machine learning tasks. Nonetheless, it remains unclear under which conditions QNNs provide concrete benefits over classical neural networks (CNNs).

arxiv-2510-06502.title: GUIDE: Guided Initialization and Distillation of Embeddings
arxiv-2510-06502.creator: Khoa Trinh, Gaurav Menghani & Erik Vee
arxiv-2510-06502.description: Abstract Algorithmic efficiency techniques such as distillation ( [ Hinton et al., 2014 ] ) are useful in improving model quality without increasing serving costs, provided a larger teacher model is available for a smaller student model to learn from during training. Standard distillation methods are limited to only forcing the student to match the teacher’s outputs.

pmc-11111270.title: The Association between Intrahousehold Food Allocation Social Norms and Thinness among Young Adolescent Girls: A Community-Based Study
pmc-11111270.creator: Hanna Gulema, Meaza Demissie, Alemayehu Worku, Tesfaye Assebe Yadeta, Nebiyou Fasil, Yemane Berhane
pmc-11111270.description: BackgroundInequalities in food allocation related to social norms among household members significantly affect the nutritional status and well-being of the vulnerable members of the household, such as adolescent girls. This study assesses the association between social norms related to intrahousehold food allocation and young adolescent girls' thinness.Materials and MethodsThe study involved 1,083 pairs of mothers/caregivers and young adolescent girls.

pmc-11357843.title: Surface water quality database for five watersheds in the Arequipa region of Southern Peru
pmc-11357843.creator: Molly Noel Rymes, Rebecca Rasmussen, Pablo A Garcia-Chevesich, Katie Burgert, Jean Long, Elsie McBride, Gisella Martínez, Kattia Martínez, Teresa Tejada, Kyle E Murray, Gary Vanzin, Jonathan O Sharp, John E McCray
pmc-11357843.description: Though surface water quality has been monitored in southern Peru over the past and current century, it has been implemented by multiple organizations. The data lacks a centralized repository and access requires logistical and temporal hurdles associated with official requests.

pmc-11378880.title: Neutrophil Extracellular Traps in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
pmc-11378880.creator: Kristine Mørk Kindberg, Kaspar Broch, Geir Øystein Andersen, Anne Kristine Anstensrud, Sissel Åkra, Sindre Woxholt, Ingvild Maria Tøllefsen, Thor Ueland, Brage Høyem Amundsen, Nils-Einar Kløw, Bente Halvorsen, Tuva B. Dahl, Camilla Huse, Sarah Louise Murphy, Jan Kristian Damås, Anders Opdahl, Rune W
pmc-11378880.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundInterleukin-6-receptor inhibition with tocilizumab improves myocardial salvage in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI). Reduced levels of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), which consist of nuclear material studded with proteins released upon neutrophil activation, might contribute to this effect.ObjectivesThe purpose of this study was to evaluate the effect of tocilizumab on NETs and investigate the association between NETs and myocardial injury in patients with STEMI.MethodsIn the ASSAIL-MI study, 199 patients with STEMI were randomized to tocilizumab or placebo during percutaneous coronary intervention.

pmc-11502649.title: A comprehensive review on Compton camera image reconstruction: from principles to AI innovations
pmc-11502649.creator: Soo Mee Kim, Jae Sung Lee
pmc-11502649.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Compton cameras have emerged as promising tools in biomedical imaging, offering sensitive gamma-ray imaging capabilities for diverse applications. This review paper comprehensively overviews the latest advancements in Compton camera image reconstruction technologies. Beginning with a discussion of the fundamental principles of Compton scattering and its relevance to gamma-ray imaging, the paper explores the key components and design considerations of Compton camera systems. We then review various image reconstruction algorithms employed in Compton camera systems, including analytical, iterative, and statistical approaches.

pmc-11591018.title: A Study of the Tennis Trust-Based System on the Psychology and Cognition of Amateur Tennis Enthusiasts
pmc-11591018.creator: Fanghuan Yang, Yi-Sub Kwak
pmc-11591018.description: Currently, amateur tennis events are developing rapidly, and the trust system has become a common rule, integrating considerations of entertainment, fitness, and cost control. However, human-centered trust system rules still face some controversy, and there is limited specialized research on the topic. This study explores amateur tennis players’ perceptions of the trust system rules.

pmc-11630807.description: ttent pre‐excitation with positive delta wave in II, AVF and negative delta wave in lead III in the 12‐lead ECG (Figure 1A). Patient had normal echocardiogram. Baseline Atrio‐His and His‐ ventricular intervals measured 84 and 37 ms respectively.

pmc-12366619.title: Exploring sex differences in mortality among acute myocardial infarction
pmc-12366619.creator: Lorenzo Cangiano, Alice Bonomi, Nicola Cosentino, Olivia Leoni, Filippo Trombara, Veronika A Myasoedova, Paolo Poggio, Daniela Trabattoni, Piergiuseppe Agostoni, Giancarlo Marenzi
pmc-12366619.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ABSTRACTBackgroundWomen with acute myocardial infarction (AMI) experience higher mortality rates than men. This disparity is influenced by factors such as older age, greater comorbidity burden, atypical symptom presentation and delays in treatment.

pmc-12447488.title: Targeting Both Monomer and Oligomer with Fibrinogen Efficiently Suppresses Amyloid Fibril Formation and Cell Toxicity of Amyloid β 1‑42
pmc-12447488.creator: Naoki Yamamoto, Keisuke Yuzu, Ken Morishima, Rintaro Inoue, Masaaki Sugiyama, Daisuke Koyama, Eri Chatani
pmc-12447488.description: The development of drugs for Alzheimer’s disease, which accounts for over half of all dementia cases, remains challenging. Amyloid β 1-42 (Aβ42) is widely recognized for its deposition in the brains of patients with Alzheimer’s disease. Furthermore, Aβ42-induced cell toxicity likely plays a role in disease onset.

pmc-12581258.title: Spatial analysis of depression and anxiety among frontline health workers during Nigeria’s COVID-19 pandemic: cross-sectional study
pmc-12581258.creator: Piwuna Christopher Goson, Uchechukwu Levi Osuagwu, Bernadine N Ekpenyong, Chundung Asabe Miner, Margaret Ojeahere, Tanko Ishaya, Khathutshelo P Mashige, Godwin Ovenseri-Ogbomo, Esther Awazzi Envuladu, Emmanuel Kwasi Abu, Chikasirimobi G Timothy, Raymond Langsi, Onyekachukwu M Amiebenomo, Richard Olo
pmc-12581258.description: BackgroundThe Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic caused considerable panic and anxiety among health workers in all countries of the world, including Nigeria. This study aimed to identify the spatial clustering for prevalence and factors associated with anxiety and depression among frontline health workers (FHWs) during COVID-19 in the 36 states of Nigeria.

pmc-12629176.title: Rapid fault healing from cementation controls the dynamics of deep slow slip and tremor
pmc-12629176.creator: Amanda M. Thomas, James M. Watkins, Nicholas Beeler, Melodie E. French, Whitney M. Behr, Mark H. Reed
pmc-12629176.description: Despite its status as one of the most important discoveries in geophysics, the physical mechanism(s) responsible for slow slip events (SSEs) are not well understood. Here, we synthesize observations of deep SSEs in the Cascadia Subduction Zone and argue that rapid, cohesive fault strengthening may control the dynamics of deep SSEs.

pmc-12679003.title: Indocyanine green fluorescence imaging in gastric cancer: Clinical efficacy, technical innovations, and future perspectives
pmc-12679003.creator: Yi-Wen Sun, Meng-Jie Liang, Xing-Zhou Wang, Wen-Ting Dong, Feng Sun, Xiao-Feng Lu, Feng Wang, Song Liu, Meng Wang, Xiao-Fei Shen, Shi-Chao Ai, Wen-Xian Guan
pmc-12679003.description: Gastric cancer (GC) ranks among the most common and deadly malignancies globally. Surgical resection with lymph node (LN) dissection is the primary treatment. The accuracy of LN dissection is essential to reduce postoperative complications and mortality. Therefore, improving the quality of LN dissection in GC surgery and refining postoperative LN staging have been the focus of clinical attention.

pmc-13099936.title: Lymph node metastasis from a small papillary renal cell carcinoma mimicking pancreatic infiltration: A case report
pmc-13099936.creator: Fumihiro Ito, Koki Kobayashi, Gaku Hayashi, Shunsuke Kamijo, Takashi Fujita
pmc-13099936.description: Small renal masses (SRMs), typically defined as tumors ≤4 cm, are generally considered indolent and often managed with active surveillance. However, metastasis can occur even in small tumors. We report a 76-year-old man with a 26-mm renal mass and a periduodenal lesion initially suspected as pancreatic invasion. EUS-FNA suggested metastatic renal cell carcinoma.

pmc-13205579.title: 3D-Printable Chontaduro (Bactris gasipaes) Gel Inks: Influence of Encapsulated Lactiplantibacillus plantarum on Rheological, Textural, and Sensory Properties
pmc-13205579.creator: Annamaria Filomena-Ambrosio, Luz-Indira Sotelo-Díaz, Yeison-Fernando Barrios-Rodríguez, Diana Vicente-Jurado, Stephania Aragón-Rojas, María Ximena Quintanilla-Carvajal, Marta Igual, Javier Martínez-Monzó, Purificación García-Segovia
pmc-13205579.description: This study evaluated the feasibility of developing 3D-printable chontaduro (Bactris gasipaes) gel inks. Freeze-dried chontaduro pulp and encapsulated Lactiplantibacillus plantarum were used. Two formulations were analysed: a control (ChC) and a probiotic ink (ChLp) containing 10% (w/w) microencapsulated cells in a maltodextrin–whey protein carrier.

pmc-13254177.title: A high-density SNP linkage map reveals a major LG3 QTL hotspot controlling early-maturity–related traits in ridge gourd (Luffa acutangula)
